feeds.title: The Shoe Snob Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Shoe Snob Blog! This blog was created to not only show the journey of one man, Justin FitzPatrick, who wanted to make the shoe industry the best it could be but also the share all of the knowledge gained along the way. Ultimately this blog is about seeing men wearing better shoes through education and sharing what is out there that deserves recognition.

feeds.title: Shoegazing
feeds.description: Shoegazing is a blog about classical quality shoes, or to be fully correct: quality shoes made with traditional construction methods. Articles about shoe care, shopping tips, guides, reviews, and more, several times a week.

feeds.title: Permanent Style » Shoes
feeds.description: Permanent Style is the leading British blog on tailoring, luxury and men's shoes and style.

feeds.title: Men's Style Pro
feeds.description: Men's style blog bringing you the how-to of menswear, dope products, lifestyle & the best ways to upgrade your overall style. MSP features exclusive range of shoes for different occasions.

feeds.title: Stridewise.com
feeds.description: Hie, I'm Nick. I'm a ravenous consumer of anything and everything related to high-end men's boots. Stridewise is where I nurture a maniacal obsession with footwear and share my findings. The blog offers insanely in-depth reviews and stories about the best men's boots on the market.

feeds.title: J.FitzPatrick Footwear Blog
feeds.description: A men's shoes Blog by Justin FitzPatrick with a vision to see more men across the world wearing better shoes.

feeds.title: The Unstitchd Blog » Footwear
feeds.description: One of the Best Men's Footwear Fashion Blog in India. Updated daily by the Top Men's Fashion Blogger India Experts featuring latest Men's Style and Men's Fashion Tips with extensive collection of footwear.

feeds.title: Footwear Guider
feeds.description: Top rated footwear reviews, products, buyer's guides, and comparison charts are just a few things. We help you to find the best available footwear product in the market.

feeds.title: George Hahn
feeds.description: George is a self-made thousandaire in hot pursuit of sartorial stealth and effective living. The idea of this online magazine is to explore and examine smart, handsome, stylish and high-quality options for the rest of us.

feeds.title: Bespoke Shoes Unlaced
feeds.description: This blog is for people who want to make shoes by hand; or those who aspire to it; or those who simply share our interest in shoemaking. Carreducker's mission is to make the most beautiful, must-have men's shoes, traditionally crafted in England with a contemporary aesthetic.

feeds.title: Just Men's Shoes Blog
feeds.description: Put your best foot forward with inspiration and style tips from Just Men's Shoes. Learn everything you need to know about the best shoe styles and trends with our men's shoe blog! At Just Men's Shoes by focusing solely on men's footwear, we're able to offer hundreds of traditional and unique designs, colours, and materials to fit your personal style.

feeds.title: Hoog Blog
feeds.description: Know the latest news and updates on men's shoes in Dubai. Find resources on private labelling, men's shoe sizes and online shoe buying tips. With a team of experienced designers who studied the latest fashion trend globally, Hoog is a leading design house and supplier, with capabilities in product development, line merchandising, and more.

feeds.title: Fumu Blog
feeds.description: A shoemaker's blog by Fumu. Check out the latest posts on the life of bespoke shoemakers in Singapore. In 2016, Tor moved to Japan to pursue the craft of handmade bespoke shoes. He established Fumu to develop and promote the handcraft sector of Singapore through shoe making.
